subject: Re: Kickoff: linear-eval as the portfolio's representation check
body:
Anders,

Plan on my side:

- Efe Lindqvist 40%, Linnea Yamada 30% on Evalline integration, Paloma Castillo 40% on the migration tooling and dashboard. Compute is negligible — L-BFGS on fixed embeddings runs on a handful of accelerators; we'll use titan-a100 scraps.
- Scope addition we discussed Tuesday, now formal: the same embedding teams keep asking how to shrink their encoders without losing representation quality. Since nothing like it exists internally, we're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch — Efe at 40% owning the recipe, Paloma supporting the training loop — so teams can compress models and immediately verify the students with linear eval. It pairs naturally with this project since linear eval is the acceptance test.

That takes us to ~1.5 FTE total. Flag now if the recipe should wait for Q3.

Jelena
